source.behavior: Open/render the authenticated account profile route for the current tenant member.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The explicit guarded workspace renders the production React shell, whose authoritative tenant context binds account.profile to the real profile API. The API rereads the active persisted TenantMembership, persisted User, and tenant-scoped roles.

runtime_path: persisted TenantMembership + User + tenant-scoped Role reread

authorization.anonymous_semantics: workspace redirects guest to canonical login
authorization.direct_id_surface: none; only the tenant route parameter is caller supplied

tenant_isolation.proof: An authenticated Tenant A member cannot resolve Tenant B workspace or profile API; both fail 404. Profile data comes from the TenantContext active membership, not a caller supplied user or membership identifier.

semantics.wordpress_runtime: not applicable to this account-profile route operation

acceptance_gates: Redis tenant lock + real queue worker + scheduler
production Docker Compose model/build/boot/real runtime smoke/cleanup

notes: No redundant route, controller, API, model, or frontend architecture was introduced: the exact base already contained the complete real runtime adaptation. This closure adds operation-specific deterministic terminal acceptance and evidence for the canonical PENDING route operation.
